title: Speed Snap
summary:
thumb
Speed Snap (officially Speed Snap Track System) is a track system introduced in 2025. It was intended as Mattel's response to research and customer input regarding Hot Wheels track sets, the studies finding a majority of kids aged 3-6 unable to build sets on their own, and parents finding them complicated, hard to store, and took up too much space....

title: Peterbilt
summary: Peterbilt Motors Company is an American truck manufacturer specializing in the production of heavy-duty (Class 8) and medium-duty (Classes 5–7) commercial vehicles. The namesake of company founder T. "Al" Peterman, it was established in 1939 from the acquisition of Fageol Truck and Motor Company, and has operated as part of PACCAR since 1958.
